name: Spot-winged Parrotlet
rangeDescription: Locally in andes of southern colombia to ecuador and northeastern peru
description: Small, rare parrot found in cloud forest in the eastern foothills of the Andes. Mostly green; male has dark wings with pale spots, and female has green wings with dark spots.

name: Collared Grosbeak
rangeDescription: Mountains of northern pakistan to southeastern tibet, northeastern myanmar, and central china
description: Large, bulky, bright-colored finch of middle to high altitude broadleaf and mixed forests. Male has a jet-black head and back and a bright yellow belly and collar.

name: Peruvian Piedtail
rangeDescription: Subtropical southeastern peru (huánuco, pasco, puno, and cusco)
description: Small hummingbird found in montane forest, especially on outlying ridges of the Andes. Green above with orange sides and a white belly that extends onto the sides of its neck; it gets its name from its bold black-and-white striped tail pattern, which is especially visible in flight.

name: Southern Banded Snake-Eagle
rangeDescription: Mainly coastal districts of southern somalia to eastern south africa
description: Chunky dark brown raptor with barred underparts. Found in and adjacent to forest, thick woodland, and exotic tree plantations, often near water.

name: Aquatic Warbler
rangeDescription: Mainly open marshes of western palearctic; winters in africa
description: Small and slim with a thick, pale eyebrow, a dark crown with a pale central crown stripe, and a heavily striped back reminiscent of the patterning of a snipe. Often perches acrobatically, gripping two stems at once.

name: Talamanca Hummingbird
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: Very large for a hummingbird; size alone separates from many other species. Distinctive in range.

name: Dunn's Lark
rangeDescription: Southern edge of sahara (mauritania to mali, chad, and central sudan)
description: A chunky, large-billed lark of desolate sandy deserts and open arid plains in northern Africa. Plain sandy-brown above and paler below, with faint and indistinct white markings on the face.

name: Dusky Purpletuft
rangeDescription: Southeastern venezuela to the guianas and far northern brazil (roraima)
description: Small, uncommon cotinga; usually seen perched in the uppermost bare branches of a high tree. At a distance, appears mostly black with a conspicuous white line down center of breast.

name: Lesser Spotted Eagle
rangeDescription: Locally in eastern europe to caspian lowlands; winters to southern africa
description: Medium-sized, compact eagle. Adults are conspicuously two toned when perched: dark flight feathers contrast with paler body.

name: Brown Parrotbill
rangeDescription: Bamboo forest of nepal to southeastern tibet, southwestern china, and northeastern myanmar
description: Dark brown parrotbill with a stout yellow bill and an arching black eyebrow. Like many other parrotbills, shows a strong affinity for high-elevation bamboo thickets, in which it moves about noisily in small flocks.

name: Rarotonga Monarch
rangeDescription: Forest undergrowth of rarotonga (southwestern cook islands)
description: A thick-set flycatcher with bicolored plumage, dark above and white below. Body darker than grayish head.

name: Salvin's Prion
rangeDescription: Breeds prince edward island and crozet island; at sea occurs in southern indian ocean and australasian seas
description: A pale powder-blue-and-white seabird with a faint grayish dark “M” across the upperwings. Note the dark blue “thumb mark” collar, the blue eye-stripe, the white eyebrow, the white throat, and the grayish cap.

name: Sulawesi Hanging-Parrot
rangeDescription: Sulawesi and adjacent islands
description: A small, brilliant green parrot with a red throat, tail, rump, and shoulder patch, a yellowish wash to the mantle, and a blackish bill. Males are pale-eyed with a red forehead that is lacking in females.

name: Slaty-backed Hemispingus
rangeDescription: Andes of western venezuela (mérida and northern táchira)
description: A beautiful small tanager with attractive contrasting colors: slate gray upperparts, orange underparts, black mask, and a bright white eyebrow. Sexes similar, but male is richer orange.

name: Capuchinbird
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, and northeastern amazonian brazil
description: Large, bizarre bird of tall rainforest. Unmistakable even when seen briefly, as they often are, flying quickly across roads or rivers.

name: White-throated Tit
rangeDescription: Birch and pine forest of northern pakistan and northwestern india
description: A tiny bird with a small bill, a large head, and a proportionally long tail. Note the white forehead, the white throat, and the partially white collar.

name: Veraguan Mango
rangeDescription: Western panama (chiriquí to southern coclé) and adjacent islands
description: Rather large hummingbird with a slightly decurved bill, extremely similar to Green-breasted Mango, and range overlap is not perfectly understood. Apparently Veraguan Mango mostly replaces Green-breasted from the Osa Peninsula to Panama City.

name: Blood-colored Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Humid coastal lowlands of the guianas
description: Small woodpecker of coastal forests, including mangroves, overgrown plantations, and urban areas. Unmistakable in its limited range.

name: Mouse-colored Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of southern ecuador and far northern peru
description: Little brown bird with a long, wispy tail found at high elevations near treeline in the Andes of southern Ecuador and northern Peru. White eye-ring, lack of an eyebrow, and brown (not chestnut) upperparts help separate it from White-chinned Thistletail; also note range.

name: Golden-bellied Starfrontlet
rangeDescription: Eastern andes of colombia (boyacá to bogotá)
description: Large, long-billed hummingbird restricted to the eastern Andes of Colombia, where it inhabits high elevation cloud forest. Both sexes are clad in iridescent green and gold plumage.
